interpretations: Use `feerate > 0.0009`; average `feerate - rebrate` over matched fee records with a nonmissing rebate; count all matched high-rate fee records; compare each group average with the unweighted average of group averages for its side; return the top 10 groups overall.
Use `feerate >= 0.0009`, with the same grouping, missing-value handling, count, side comparison, and global top 10.

Use `feerate > 0.0009`; treat a missing `rebrate` as zero when calculating the net rate; count all matched high-rate fee records; compare group averages with their side’s unweighted average; return the top 10 overall.

Use `feerate > 0.0009`; exclude records with a missing rebate from both the group average and the displayed record count; compare group averages with their side’s unweighted average; return the top 10 overall.
Use `feerate > 0.0009`; include orders with a missing `dealedge` as a separate side for grouping and comparison; ignore missing net rates in averages; return the top 10 overall.

queries:
WITH fee_groups AS (
  SELECT
    o.dealedge AS side,
    f.feerange,
    f.feecoin,
    COUNT(*) AS high_rate_fee_count,
    AVG(CASE WHEN f.rebrate IS NOT NULL THEN f.feerate - f.rebrate END) AS avg_net_fee_rate
  FROM fees AS f
  JOIN orders AS o ON o.recordvault = f.orderslink
  WHERE f.feerate > 0.0009
  GROUP BY o.dealedge, f.feerange, f.feecoin
),
compared AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    AVG(avg_net_fee_rate) OVER (PARTITION BY side) AS side_avg_of_group_averages
  FROM fee_groups
)
SELECT
  side,
  feerange,
  feecoin,
  high_rate_fee_count,
  avg_net_fee_rate,
  side_avg_of_group_averages,
  avg_net_fee_rate - side_avg_of_group_averages AS difference_from_side_avg
FROM compared
ORDER BY avg_net_fee_rate DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH high_rate_fees AS (
    SELECT
        f.feerange,
        o.dealedge,
        f.feerate - COALESCE(f.rebrate, 0) AS net_rate
    FROM fees AS f
    JOIN orders AS o ON o.recordvault = f.orderslink
    WHERE f.feerate > 0.0009
),
side_averages AS (
    SELECT dealedge, AVG(net_rate) AS side_avg_net_rate
    FROM high_rate_fees
    GROUP BY dealedge
),
group_averages AS (
    SELECT
        feerange,
        dealedge,
        COUNT(*) AS fee_record_count,
        AVG(net_rate) AS avg_net_rate
    FROM high_rate_fees
    GROUP BY feerange, dealedge
)
SELECT
    g.feerange,
    g.dealedge,
    g.fee_record_count,
    g.avg_net_rate,
    s.side_avg_net_rate
FROM group_averages AS g
JOIN side_averages AS s USING (dealedge)
ORDER BY g.avg_net_rate - s.side_avg_net_rate DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH group_averages AS (
    SELECT
        o.dealedge,
        f.feerange,
        COUNT(*) AS record_count,
        AVG(f.rebtotal) AS average_rebate
    FROM fees AS f
    JOIN orders AS o ON o.recordvault = f.orderslink
    WHERE f.feerate > 0.0009
      AND f.rebtotal IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY o.dealedge, f.feerange
)
SELECT
    dealedge,
    feerange,
    record_count,
    average_rebate,
    AVG(average_rebate) OVER (PARTITION BY dealedge) AS side_average_rebate
FROM group_averages
ORDER BY average_rebate DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT
    f.feerange,
    COALESCE(o.dealedge, 'Missing') AS dealedge,
    AVG(f.feerate - f.rebrate) AS avg_net_rate
FROM fees AS f
JOIN orders AS o ON o.recordvault = f.orderslink
WHERE f.feerate > 0.0009
GROUP BY f.feerange, COALESCE(o.dealedge, 'Missing')
ORDER BY avg_net_rate DESC
LIMIT 10
